description: List the event names create_webhook and update_webhook accept, such as content.changed, order.paid or record.created. Read-only and takes no input. Returns a plain array of strings. The list is filtered to the caller: an event whose data needs a permission the caller lacks (order events need orders view, for example) is left out, and subscribing to it would be refused.
name: list_webhook_event_types
title: List webhook event types
